evidence.limits: No whisper.srt available; speech is taken from burned-in word-by-word captions (complete for 0-5 s, sampled once a second afterwards, so some phrases between samples are missed, e.g. the caption between 'שוויץ שהיא לא' at 16 s and the gear cost at 18 s). Whether the amounts are real, and whether the trips were paid for by Matan, cannot be verified from the frames. Music and sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Voiceover-style montage of Matan's own travel clips from September: he totals what he spent on four holidays (a hotel weekend in Jaffa, Switzerland, a team trip to Cyprus, a spontaneous Prague trip) ending with a total of 113,000 NIS.
audience: His followers; viewers curious about his lifestyle and how much money wealth lets you spend.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption 'לא תאמינו כמה הכל עלה' matches the video, which is a spending tally. The cover is a restaurant frame from the Switzerland dinner (Matan in a grey beanie with a steak) carrying the caption text 'מלון ארבע העונות והבזבזים יצא', not a frame from the opening.

opening.first_frame: A man jumps off a wooden pier into turquoise sea (the camera is behind the jumpers); no caption on the first frame.
opening.s0_1: Two men jump into the sea; the caption 'אז כמה כסף הוצאתי' builds in white with a green highlight on one word at a time from 0.25 s; at 1.0 s a cut to a cow beside an alpine path.
opening.s1_3: Caption continues 'על חופשות בחודש' (1.25 to 2.0 s) over the cow shot; at 2.0 s a cut to a river and castle (Prague view) with 'ספטמבר?'; at 2.75 s a cable-car queue with 'בוא נראה.'
opening.s3_5: At 3.5 s a coastal view of Tel Aviv and Jaffa with 'החופשה הראשונה הייתה סוף שבוע'; at 4.75 s a hotel window shot 'במלון סטאי ביפו'.
opening.visual_hook: Very fast travel b-roll (sea jump, cow, a European city, a queue, a beach) under a money question.
opening.spoken_hook: Speech starts at 0 s: 'אז כמה כסף הוצאתי על חופשות בחודש ספטמבר? בואו נראה' (0 to 3.4 s), then the first trip and its cost at 3.4 s (machine transcript).
opening.text_hook: אז כמה כסף הוצאתי על חופשות בחודש ספטמבר?
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'אז כמה כסף הוצאתי על חופשות בחודש ספטמבר?' is a self-contained question with an implied payoff
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: yes (the money question; no amount yet)
opening.works_without_sound: yes: word-by-word captions and visuals carry the idea

visual.subject_placement: Mostly landscape and POV shots, with Matan appearing in the frame at 7 s (selfie), 13 to 14 s (snow, holding his book), 15 and 34 to 35 s (dinner), 24 s (plane), 28 s (VR), 37 to 38 s (beer bath), 41 to 42 s (flight meal) and 43 to 44 s (viewpoint).
visual.setting: A sea pier, an alpine road, Prague's riverside, a hotel in Jaffa, a plane window, a Swiss lake and village, a mountain snow field, a restaurant, a train, a gear shop, a mountain suspension bridge, a game arcade, an airport, an astronomical clock, a luxury hotel with a car outside, a beer spa, a plane meal, and a mountain viewpoint.
visual.lighting: Natural daylight in most shots; mixed indoor lights for restaurants and arcade.
visual.color_contrast: Saturated outdoor colours, strong blues and greens; white text with a green rounded highlight on the current word.
visual.props_and_gestures: Selfie recording, a phone call at the viewpoint, his book 'לשרוף את הספינות' held in the snow at 13 to 14 s, VR headset, a beer glass.
visual.supporting_footage: Phone screenshots in an inset at 7 s (a hotel booking and a question card 'כמה עלה לך המלון?'), a letterboxed shop clip at 17 to 19 s, and a computer screen clip at 17 s; all other shots are his own travel footage.
visual.faces_blurred: yes (one bystander's face is blurred or covered at about 31 s; most others are not identifiable)
visual.visual_progression: 0-5 s fast b-roll under the question; 5-7 s Jaffa hotel; 7 s selfie and booking screenshot for 12,000; 8-9 s plane window; 10-14 s Swiss lake, house, snow selfie with his book and the flight-plus-hotel 27,300; 15-16 s Swiss dinner and train; 17-19 s shop with gear 22,000; 20-23 s bridge and waterfall with the Switzerland total 49,300; 24-25 s plane and a Cyprus trail; 26-29 s arcade and VR with 9,400; 30-35 s Prague airport, clock, a glowing table, a hotel bed and the Four Seasons dinner with 42,800; 36-38 s car and beer bath with the Prague total; 39-40 s Swiss village with the grand total 113,000; 41-44 s plane meal and mountain viewpoint with a closing line.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is a frame of the Swiss dinner (30 to 35 s) with its caption, but it does not show the opening or the total.
visual.ui_interference: Captions sit at about 55 to 70 percent of the frame height (inside the bottom 35 percent zone for the second caption line); the shop and computer clips at 17 to 19 s are letterboxed with black bars.

editing.edit_function: Information and stimulation: each trip is shown with new locations every 1 to 2 seconds, and the amount is a green-highlighted caption word, so viewers can follow a running total.
pacing_changes: t=0-5s: a cut every 1 to 2 s
t=7s: a longer 1.5 s screenshot shot
t=10-14s: slower scenic shots of a lake and a house
t=20-23s: bridge and waterfall at a calmer pace
editing.ending: A plane meal clip with 'כדאי שאני אטוס בפעם הבאה ואגיד', then a mountain viewpoint with the caption 'לכם כמה יצא לי.'; the last half-second is silent.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the ending line 'I should fly next time and tell you how much it cost me' and the fast montage of dozens of places reward a second pass; the comment sample suggests people re-read the amounts.

sound.delivery: Loudness is steady at about -18 to -25 dB with brief dips around 3 to 4, 8, 11, 41 and 45 s; the voice-like level suggests a continuous voiceover or music and speech mix, but this cannot be confirmed. The last half second drops to -88 dB.
sound.sync: Word-by-word captions with a moving green highlight follow a continuous narration; cuts occur on phrase changes and the amount captions are held for 2 to 3 s each.

text.colour_coding: White text with a rounded green highlight on the word being spoken; the figures (₪12,000, ₪27,300, ₪22,000, ₪49,300, ₪9,400, ₪42,800, ₪113,000) are highlighted in the same green box.
text.placement: Middle to lower-middle of the frame, two lines.
text.style: White semi-bold sans with a soft dark outline, green rounded highlight per word.
text.density_and_read_time: One to four words per beat, new beat about every 0.5 to 1 s; easy to read.
text.language: Casual first person, a series of amounts and place names ('לבד לשוויץ ל-8', 'סך הכל טיול ספונטני לפראג'); a brag and a joke about the total.
text.caption_structure: One teaser line with two money-bag emojis: 'לא תאמינו כמה הכל עלה'; no hashtags; no CTA.
text.rtl_notes: Amounts such as '12,000₪' and '27,300₪' render with the shekel sign at the left and a comma in the number, mixed with Hebrew words; one caption shows the shekel sign before the digits ('₪ 12,000') because of bidi order.

story.setup: He asks how much he spent on holidays in September.
story.stakes: A total that the caption promises will be unbelievable.
story.progression: Four trips each with its cost: a weekend at a Jaffa hotel with his partner (12,000 NIS); Switzerland alone (flight and hotel 27,300, gear and shopping 22,000, total 49,300); a four-day Cyprus trip with the team (9,400); a spontaneous Prague trip with his partner (42,800); then the total.
story.resolution: He asks viewers to write where he should fly next time and says he will then tell them what it cost (spoken at about 40.7 to 44 s).
story.payoff_delivered: yes: the total is revealed at about 38 to 40 s
friction_points: t=0-5s: heavy b-roll before any figure appears (interpretation)
t=20-24s: a break in the money stream with scenic shots (interpretation)
t=41-44s: the last lines repeat the premise (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: machine transcript: 'תרשמו לי לאן כדאי שאני אטוס בפעם הבאה'

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 43 comments is not representative. A large share reacts to the display of wealth: some mock or criticise it ('כסף הוא דת', 'זה אמור להיות פלקס?'), some ask where the money comes from ('מאיפה הכסף?'), several suggest destinations ('ממליצה על יפן', 'פעם הבאה לתאילנד'), and two share travel-deal links; a few defend him.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: A single clap emoji reply under a friend's comment.

conversion.cta_timing: none for a conversion step; a spoken comment request at about 40.7 to 44 s asks where to fly next
conversion.proof: Own travel footage and booking screenshots.
conversion.cta_fits_content: n/a: no CTA (only the book in his hands at 13 to 14 s hints at his product)

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film; mostly own footage. Identifiable companions appear (partner, team members, hotel guests, a bystander partly covered at 31 s), a luxury car and hotel brand names. Cost claims are unverified.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a clear money question in the first 2 seconds, specific numbers on screen for every trip, constant visual novelty and a running-total structure create a reason to wait for the sum; the display of wealth also polarises, and the 259 comments (1.89 per 1,000 views) show it provoked reaction.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: viewers may read it as bragging with no lesson, and the commenters ask 'what is the point'.

standout_moments.what: A pier jump as the first image under a money question.
Selfie with a booking screenshot and a question card: documentary proof of the first figure.
Snow selfie holding his book on a mountain: a subtle product placement.
Grand total 'ספטמבר 113,000₪' over a Swiss village: the payoff.
